### About Us

Om Sai Crane Service introduces itself as one of the Leading Suppliers of Cranes and all other Heavy Equipments since last 16 years. We have been in operation since 1992, since then we have steadily built, expanded and maintained a loyal client base, working alongside large National & International Corporations, Government agencies, Construction companies and major Chemical & Pharmaceutical Industries. We are one of the leading names in the field of providing equipment rental and contract management services to various industries.Our fleet of executives includes experienced and skilled Crane operators, mechanics, hard working mechanical helpers and patient supervisors, who are all working with great zeal and dedication to help the firm reach its zenith. The reins of the Company are controlled by our Owner and Managing Director Mr. Loknath Muppineti and Business Development officer Mr. Dinesh Muppineti who is a Masters in Business Administration. We have segmented our work force into various departments such as Finance Dept, Accounts Dept. and Maintenance Dept., which ensures Quality work, in Minimum time. Om Sai Crane service has ware housing facilities for all its cranes and also a fully equipped work shop with skilled mechanics and hard working labors at our premises, which caters to all types of Repairs & Maintenance, making sure that all machines are well maintained at all times, enabling us to work round the clock. With all our crane hire packages, you will receive, apart from an excellent fleet of latest specifications cranes, emergency break down and recovery services.Our cranes for hire are modern and are up to mark with the latest specifications and standard, all cranes are operated by experienced and reliable crane drivers, therefore om Sai Crane Service can assure you work of high standards at all times.
